content: Plan a wet-lab protocol to measure E. coli growth curves at 30, 37 and 42 degrees in LB medium and fit a logistic model to each curve.
Protocol: inoculate three flasks from one overnight culture to OD600 0.05, sample every 30 minutes for 10 hours, read OD600 in triplicate. I will fit a four-parameter logistic to each series.
python: fit_logistic(od600_readings.csv) -> doubling times per temperature
doubling time: 30C 48 min, 37C 22 min, 42C 31 min; R^2 > 0.98 for all fits
Now design PCR primers for the 600 bp region flanking the insert in this plasmid map so we can confirm the construct before the next culture.
Two primer pairs proposed with Tm 60 to 62 degrees and no predicted hairpins; expected amplicons 612 and 640 bp. Run a gradient PCR at 58 to 64 degrees to pick the cleaner pair.
